external_theorem.source: Nicolas Prcovic, Narrowing Extended Resolution, ICTAI 2012
external_theorem.role: normalizes derived resolvent width to at most 3 with polynomial proof translation

definitions.n0: number of root variables, n0 <= N
definitions.m: number of root clauses, m <= N under ordinary explicit encoding
definitions.K: number of extension variables in an ER3 refutation

proved_lemmas.clause_universe: The number of distinct width<=3 clauses over V variables is at most 1 + 2V + C(2V,2) + C(2V,3) = O(V^3).
proved_lemmas.duplicate_elimination: Retaining the earliest derivation of each repeated clause and redirecting later uses preserves a valid acyclic DAG refutation.
proved_lemmas.compressed_size: Some ER3 DAG refutation using K extension variables has size O(N + K + (N+K)^3), up to ordinary logarithmic encoding factors.
proved_lemmas.sufficiency: If every UNSAT CNF of length N admits some ER3 refutation with K <= N^c for fixed c, then every UNSAT CNF has polynomial-size ER/B2 certificates.
proved_lemmas.necessity_from_global_e2: If ER/B2 is p-bounded, ER3 p-simulation yields polynomial-size ER3 proofs and hence polynomially many extension-variable introductions.

equivalence: GLOBAL_ER_B2_P_BOUNDEDNESS iff UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_EXTENSION_COUNT_IN_SOME_ER3_REFUTATION, up to polynomial translations

new_exact_gate.statement: Prove or refute existence of fixed c,N0 such that every UNSAT CNF F of length N>=N0 has some ER3 refutation using K(F)<=N^c extension variables.
